title: 모음 ㅐ·ㅔ·ㅖ 구별하고 읽기
summary: Practice distinguishing and reading the Korean vowels ㅐ, ㅔ, ㅖ through minimal pairs and common words. Includes quick spelling choices to reinforce accurate vowel recognition.
objective: Learners will tell ㅐ, ㅔ, and ㅖ apart by spelling, and read simple words that contain these vowels correctly.
exercises: Choose the word that matches the meaning: dog -> 개 / 게
Choose the correct spelling: (pear) 배 / 베
Choose the correct spelling: (lemon) 레몬 / 래몬
Choose the correct spelling: (egg) 계란 / 게란
Fill in the blank with the correct vowel: ㅊ_ㄱ (book): ㅐ / ㅔ / ㅖ
Fill in the blank with the correct vowel: ㅇ_쁘다 (to be pretty): ㅐ / ㅔ / ㅖ

letters.as: like the vowel in "bed" (in modern standard Korean, ㅐ and ㅔ sound almost the same; tell them apart mostly by spelling and meaning, e.g., 개 dog / 게 crab)
like "ye" in "yes" (after a consonant it may be pronounced like ㅔ, e.g., 계란 [게란])
